verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that comments on the back of a Trello card let a team 'have a real discussion' (trello-comm-12). That is threaded, card-level discussion rather than team chat. Other items only show content captured from Slack into the Inbox (trello-docs-1) or vague 'cross-team collaboration' claims (trello-docs-8). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of in-app chat or messaging, real-time or direct team conversations, channels or DMs, and independent hands-on corroboration of discussion features.
